engine.name: Colibri
engine.backends_quote: Heterogeneous execution. CPU, CUDA, Metal, NUMA memory, and partial or full [...] an experimental Metal backend [...] and a Vulkan backend brings the expert tier, dense projections, and the MLA attention core to any GPU with a Vulkan 1.2 driver
engine.requirements_quote: None of them needs a GPU. [...] A GPU only ever makes it faster. Speed is set by your disk, because the experts are streamed from it — expect a fraction of a token per second on a slow drive and a few per second on a fast one with the cache warm.

models.name: GLM-5.2 / 5.3
models.quote: GLM-5.2/5.3 | ~372 GB | 16 GB min, 24 GB comfortable | not needed; [...] the routed experts cost 4.5 GB per token against GLM-5.2's 12.7

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
models.container: int4 gs64 routed experts, BF16 dense
models.quote: GLM-5.3-Flash | ~195 GB converted | 25 GB (12 GB weights at int4 + expert cache) | not needed

models.name: Inkling
models.container: int4 (nbeerbower) with the int4 dense container
models.quote: Inkling | ~469 GB | 25 GB with the int4 dense container, ~120 GB without | not needed

models.name: Kimi K3
models.quote: Kimi K3 | ~1.6 TB | 32 GB+ | not needed

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
models.container: official checkpoint, fp4 experts + fp8 dense
models.quote: DeepSeek V4 Flash | ~167 GB (REAP 150B: ~85 GB) | 16 GB min, 32 GB comfortable | optional; any NVIDIA card from the GTX 10 series up [...] makes prefill 5-10x and decode ~2.5x faster

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.container: official checkpoint, fp4 experts + fp8 dense, no conversion
models.quote: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash | 552B / 16B | official checkpoint, no conversion [...] 203 GB of it is an n-gram memory read from disk [...] the routed experts cost 4.5 GB per token (not in the requirements table: disk and RAM unstated)

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
models.quote: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | ~185.5 GB (official FP8 checkpoint) | 16 GB min, 24 GB comfortable at the default context | not supported; CPU only; 125B + 51B n-gram / 6B

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
models.quote: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | ~20 GB (int4-gs64 container) | 24 GB (needs full RAM residency) | optional; the CUDA VRAM expert tier measured 1.44 -> 10.05 tok/s (7.0x) on two 8 GB cards

models.name: OLMoE 1B-7B
models.quote: OLMoE | ~7 GB (int8 container) | 8 GB | not needed. expert_gb_per_token DERIVED by jacar.es from config.json: 16 layers x 8 experts x 6.43 MB int8 = 823 MB when every expert misses
